result.answer:
Excellent news! Here's your eligibility determination:

## **You are eligible for damage compensation**

**Eligibility basis:**
- Your property is in Zone 4 with verified structural damage, which qualifies you under the agency's eligibility rules ([/claims/eligibility/](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/eligibility/))

---

## **Extra support you qualify for:**

You are entitled to **three forms of additional support**:

1. **Assessment fee waiver (¥12,000)** – Because you have two approved claims from separate incidents within the last 12 months, you are exempt from the standard assessment fee ([/claims/faq/](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/faq/))

2. **Hardship supplement** – Your annual household income of ¥3,600,000 is below the ¥4,000,000 threshold, so you qualify for an additional hardship supplement ([/claims/eligibility/](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/eligibility/))

3. **Business interruption compensation** – As a commercial property owner, you can claim additional compensation for business interruption caused by the damage ([/claims/damage-compensation/](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/damage-compensation/))

---

## **Documents you must bring:**

1. **Incident report receipt** – Must have been filed within 72 hours of the incident (your incident was 21 days ago, so ensure this exists)
2. **Damage survey** – Photographs and an itemised loss schedule
3. **Proof of ownership or tenancy** – For the Tanaka Bakery property
4. **Household income certificate** – Required because you're claiming the hardship supplement
5. **Business registration certificate** – Required for your business interruption claim

---

## **Important deadlines:**

- **Incident report:** Must have been filed within 72 hours (your deadline has passed, but if you filed it on time, you're covered)
- **Claim submission:** You have 90 days from the incident to file (you have approximately 69 days remaining)
- **Processing:** Expect an assessor visit within 15 business days, with a determination within 45 days

A select counts if its visible LABEL matches the expected option value with case and punctuation collapsed — "Structural alteration" satisfies "structural-alteration". A UI agent picks the option it can read; scoring the label as a miss would measure transcription rather than comprehension.

These three were ADDED AFTER defects were found in this scorer, not designed in from the start. Answer text is normalised before matching: NFKC, Unicode dashes folded to "-", non-breaking spaces to " ", curly quotes to straight, and markdown emphasis markers removed. A model that writes "rolling 12‑month" or "only **one** approved" is making the same claim as one that does not.
A conclusion is read from position, not vocabulary: a correct answer quotes the rule it applies, so waiver wording inside a quotation does not outrank an explicit finding stated earlier.
Affirmative phrases are only counted when not negated within the preceding ~28 characters, so "should not have to pay" is not read as "have to pay".
